products.name: distribution.dev
products.tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
products.description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

products.name: Granular.Build
products.tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
products.description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

products.name: Snag by Parallel
products.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
products.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

products.name: Clam AI
products.tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
products.description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

products.name: Viktor Code
products.tagline: Coding agents know your repo. Viktor knows your company.
products.description: Coding agents know your repository. Viktor knows your company: your customers, your metrics and the decisions behind the work. So you give him a business outcome, not a ticket. He splits it into the technical and the non-technical work. He opens pull requests on your GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repos and brings them back for your review. His projects belong to the whole team, in Slack, Teams or Discord. Anyone can code now. Free to start, with up to $100 in credits.

products.name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
products.tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
products.description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

products.name: Claude Ship
products.tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
products.description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

products.name: frwrd.to
products.tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
products.description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

products.name: Kodak SlideTag
products.tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
products.description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

products.name: Omi X 2.0
products.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
products.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

products.name: tday.com
products.tagline: AI-recorded Screen Studio style editable demos
products.description: Most features ship without a demo video. A good one takes hours to script, record, retake, voice and edit. Ask for a demo in one line from Claude Code, Cursor or Codex. Your coding agent records your real app on your machine, localhost included, and tday adds the voice, cursor, zooms, captions and your brand. Edit any narration line, then use it in your launch, docs or changelog. Web, desktop, terminal, iPhone and Android apps. Your code never leaves your machine. Free for 5 saved demos.

products.name: Agenda Hero Magic Labs
products.tagline: Any schedule. Any layout. Any style.
products.description: We’re replacing the static PDF calendar with a new kind of artifact built for date and time. From the team offsite to the soccer season, make a beautifully designed plan. It’s powered by live data, so when the plan changes, the design and subscribed calendars stay up to date. Try it today in Agenda Hero Magic Labs.

products.name: Valley
products.tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
products.description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

products.name: Willow iOS 2.0
products.tagline: No switching apps while you dictate
products.description: Tap the mic and talk without leaving the app you’re writing in. Willow brings dictation and Scribe into your iPhone keyboard, alongside swipe typing, smarter autocorrect, emoji, and cursor control. Speak a longer thought, type a quick edit, and keep going.

products.name: doola MCP
products.tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
products.description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.
